# GuGu

> Vietnamese beauty & wellness booking marketplace. One universal Expo app (iOS, Android, web) plus a NestJS + PostgreSQL API in a TypeScript monorepo. AI-first: every domain has a subagent, a skill and agent-friendly docs.

Start with AGENTS.md. Customers pay at the salon (no payment processing). Vietnamese is the default locale; English is second.

## Core
- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): entry point, non-negotiables, where things are
- [AI-first conventions](ai-first-conventions.md): subagent/skill/doc formats and per-domain deliverables
- [Glossary](glossary.md): vi/en domain terms used in code and UI

## Agents and skills
- [Orchestrator agent](../.claude/agents/orchestrator.md): routes multi-domain work, runs reviewers, reports status
- [Architecture agent](../.claude/agents/architecture.md): monorepo, contracts pipeline, ADRs, architecture review
- [Architecture skill](../.claude/skills/architecture/SKILL.md): add module/endpoint/package/ADR, upgrade procedures
- [Ownership map](../.claude/skills/architecture/references/ownership.md): which agent owns which path
